mapper.select: SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, APPLICATION_ID, PAYMENT_SEQ, PAYMENT_DATE, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, PAID_YN, CREATED_AT FROM LOAN_REPAYMENT_SCHEDULE WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId} ORDER BY PAYMENT_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOAN_REPAYMENT_SCHEDULE (APPLICATION_ID, PAYMENT_SEQ, PAYMENT_DATE, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, PAID_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{paymentSeq}, #{paymentDate}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidYn}, #{createdAt})
